WITH RefSource AS (
SELECT 'CRM' SourceSystemCode,	'Customer Relationship Management' SourceSystemName,	'FCBS' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEP' SourceSystemCode,	'Deposit' SourceSystemName,	'FCBS' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'LNS' SourceSystemCode,	'Loans' SourceSystemName,	'FCBS' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'GLD' SourceSystemCode,	'General Ledger' SourceSystemName,	'FCBS' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'CCD' SourceSystemCode,	'Credit Cards' SourceSystemName,	'Asccend' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'TRY' SourceSystemCode,	'Treasury' SourceSystemName,	'Calypso' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'TRU' SourceSystemCode,	'Trust' SourceSystemName,	'Intellect' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'SEC' SourceSystemCode,	'Securities' SourceSystemName,	'BOSS' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'SED' SourceSystemCode,	'Securities Digital' SourceSystemName,	'CBSec Digital' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'MBK' SourceSystemCode,	'Mobile Banking' SourceSystemName, 'Digital' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'RIB' SourceSystemCode,	'Retail Internet Banking' SourceSystemName, 	'Digital' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'ATM' SourceSystemCode,	'Automated Teller Machine' SourceSystemName,	'Digital' SourceSystemDescription	UNION ALL
SELECT 'BOB' SourceSystemCode,	'Corporate Internet Banking' SourceSystemName,	'Digital' SourceSystemDescription
)

INSERT INTO [DW].[RefSourceSystem] 	([SourceSystemCode],[SourceSystemName],	[SourceSystemDesc]) 
SELECT * FROM RefSource
SELECT * FROM [DW].[RefSourceSystem]
